How well the identifier knows it

Of 12 validation photos of Drosera fulva (photos the model never trained on), its top guess was right for 4. It gave a confident answer for 9 of them, and 4 of those were right.

Only 26 training photos: species with fewer than 40 are identified less reliably.

Most often mistaken for

  • Drosera ordensis (3 photos)
  • Drosera brevicornis (2 photos)
  • Drosera dilatatopetiolaris (2 photos)
